body.p: This is a list of open issues that need to be resolved for FreeBSD 6.2. If you have any updates for this list, please e-mail re@FreeBSD.org.

li.a: Problems Discovered by Kernel Stress Test Suite

tr.td: Several stability fixes for bce(4) were merged from HEAD to RELENG_6 around 20061024. Initial testing results have been promising, but more testing reports would be useful.
Scott Long, Jack F. Vogel, Gleb Smirnoff, Kris Kennaway

Several difficult-to-diagnose stability issues have been observed in the em(4) driver since August. As of 20061027, a newer driver provided by Intel (version 6.2.9) has been committed to RELENG_6 for testing. UPDATE: Additional changes committed 20061110 fix some other observed stability problems and restore missing jumbo frame functionality.

A bug in sysinstall(8) could result in it failing to install a kernel on a new disk if the user did not choose a distribution from the distribution menu. This is believed to have been fixed as of 20061029, but could use more testing.
A recently-committed patch to ggated(8) is believed to fix some fairly serious problems, as reported in PR kern/104829.
Several deadlocks and locking bugs have been fixed in devfs(5).
Several workarounds have been committed for known problems in the tty(4) layer.

body.p: The system is continuously being subjected to Peter Holm's Kernel Stress Test Suite. The following issues have recently been discovered from this test suite.
